newsitem.title: USA: Hilite sees FY97 profits below FY96.
newsitem.headline: Hilite sees FY97 profits below FY96.

text.p: Hilite Industries Inc said on Wednesday that it foresaw profits in fiscal 1997 would be below those of fiscal 1996.
The auto parts company said in a statement the fall in earnings for the first quarter of 1997 was mostly caused by operational problems at its specialty components and assemblies division.

"We expect the...division to restrain earnings over the nearer term. However, we anticipate that Hilite will be solidly profitable in fiscal 1997, although earnings will not reach the level achieved in fiscal 1996," chief executive Daniel Brady said.

The company reported net income of $3.6 million, or $0.74 a share, in fiscal 1996 and operating income of $7.4 million. For the first quarter of 1997 it had earnings of $403,000, or $0.08 a share, versus earnings of $1.03 million, or $0.21 a share, for the same period the year before.
